Two slices of toast: one with jam, one with a little butter. Bread ~35 g each = 70 g, ~185 kcal. Jam ~15 g = 40 kcal. Butter ~3 g = 22 kcal. Apple medium ~150 g = 78 kcal. Two egg bites ~50 g each = 100 g, ~170 kcal.

Total mass ≈ 70 + 15 + 3 + 150 + 100 = 338 g. Total kcal ≈ 185 + 40 + 22 + 78 + 170 = 495.
